tools.name: plan_steps
tools.description: Lay out every step of the job up front, in plain English a non-technical person understands: 2 to 8 short names in order, each under 40 characters and starting with a verb. The first step starts right away.

tools.name: report_progress
tools.description: Report progress on the current step: its plain-English name and a percent from 0 to 100. Report 100 the moment a step finishes; the next one starts by itself.
